card.name: Digits inside reference numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits or decimal points partway through long numbers such as ISBNs, phone numbers, DOIs and population figures. It also appears inside some codes like CYP2C8.

modes.label: ISBN and phone digits
modes.description: A digit inside an ISBN or 1-800 phone number.

modes.label: Decimal point in statistics
modes.description: The point inside a large figure with decimals, such as a population or density.
modes.example: Flag of India |Population (In Millions)||1,241<<.>>49| |Human Development Index||

modes.label: Citation code piece
modes.description: A short chunk inside a DOI string.
modes.example: inimäki, and E. Hemminki. Human Reproduction journal. doi:10.1093/humrep/d<<es>>294 In 201

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long ID-style numbers, like ISBNs, phone numbers and decimals.
